answer: Each epoch opens a harbor gate: an identity acts only with a fresh hash-lottery ticket bound to the epoch seed and its key, anyone can verify. Every identity locks a 25,000 POA bond. 1,000 fakes must mint 1,000 tickets and lock 25,000,000 POA per epoch; an honest agent mints one ticket and locks 25,000 POA once. A forged or reused ticket triggers enforcement: bond seized and burned, identity banned 12 epochs. Crossing a frozen tundra to a lagoon harbor is cheap once, ruinous at scale. Limitation: the gate favors faster hardware, so rich operators edge out equally honest, slower ones.
